title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Pure Mathematics Paper 1
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Pure Mathematics Paper 1: twelve compulsory 10-mark questions, 120 marks, 3 hours. The paper structure is not printed in the syllabus: this mock assumes the Statistics pattern. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** the questions. You have 3 hours. The paper structure is not printed in the syllabus: this mock assumes the Statistics pattern.

- Show all your working. Give non-exact answers to 3 significant figures (angles in degrees to 1 decimal place) unless a question says otherwise.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The marks per question are our convention; real papers vary question by question. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
